# Adyntel

Adyntel provides an API to retrieve LinkedIn ads for a given company using the company's domain or LinkedIn Page ID.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/adyntel/.

## Actions

- **Get Google Ads By Company**: Retrieve all google ads for a given company domain.
- **Search Meta Ads**: Search the meta ad library.
- **Search TikTok Ads**: Search for ads on tiktok using a keyword.
